boundaries.name: regev-stark-verification
boundaries.obligation: E-1/E-2/E-3 Regev STARK proving and verification at RegevSecurityLevel::Test are opaque; nothing about their soundness or the Test-level parameters is modeled.

boundaries.name: structural-transport-verifier-verifies-nothing
boundaries.obligation: Every inter-channel test uses a verifier that accepts exactly the empty envelope; real intmax transport proof verification is never exercised by this file.

boundaries.name: state-update-verifier-semantics
boundaries.obligation: The witness verifiers the tests call are modeled in Zkp.Implementation.ChannelStateUpdate (not imported here); this module records the expected outcomes as data and derives nothing about those verifiers.

boundaries.name: close-circuit-proof-and-fixture
boundaries.obligation: The full close-circuit proof uses close_circuit::test_fixture artifacts and 3 fixture Falcon signatures; see the CloseCircuit model and its fixture boundary.

boundaries.name: placeholder-member-signatures
boundaries.obligation: Channel states and the small block carry structural_cosign_placeholder signatures; the native flow does not verify member signatures, so nothing here is evidence about N-of-N authorization.

boundaries.name: fixture-economic-consistency
boundaries.obligation: Fund amounts (100, 200) are not the sums of genesis balances (90, 60) and roots such as member_pubkeys_root, intmax_state_root and tx_tree_root are placeholder words; the fixture is structurally, not economically, consistent.

boundaries.name: test-execution-not-attested
boundaries.obligation: All tests are ignored in debug builds and run only under --release; whether they were executed is not attested here.
